classification.difficultyReason: Open box: one decision to omit the lid, then add the base and four walls from labelled dimensions.

content.prompt: Work out the area of cardboard needed to make this open box.

answer.worked:
There is no top, so the open box has a base and four sides.

Base: $12\times8=96\text{ cm}^2$.

Four sides: $(12\times5)\times2+(8\times5)\times2=120+80=200\text{ cm}^2$.
$$\begin{align*}A&=96+200\\A&=296\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
